entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
I need to make a return.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Alex. I can certainly help you with that. Can I start with your name and order number, please?
Thank you, Sarah. Let me pull that up. Okay, I see the order for the VeloFit cycling shoes, delivered about two and a half months ago. What specifically is the issue with them?
They don't fit right. I've tried adjusting the cleats, but they just give me blisters. I want a refund.

I'm sorry to hear they're causing you blisters, that's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I can absolutely process that return for you. I see here you received them 76 days ago, which is well within our 90-day return policy.
Well, I should hope so. That is your policy.

Yes, absolutely. I have just initiated the return. I'm sending an email to you right now with a prepaid shipping label. Once our warehouse receives the shoes, we'll issue that full refund back to your original payment method. You should see it post in about 3-5 business days after that.
That's everything on my end for the return. Was there anything else I could help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, Sarah. Have a good rest of your day.
